scope: family-reduction analytic semantics and scale-covariant certificate rank decisions

packets.before: fixed-fibre A-hat and eta checks were promoted into an unearned vanishing family eta form and GAUGE fork
packets.after: the surviving family eta-form base integral is explicit and the unconstructed actual GU family leaves the fork unresolved

packets.before: four live certificate surfaces used absolute or unit-floored singular-value thresholds for rank decisions
packets.after: rank is measured relative to each nonzero matrix scale or a covariantly scaling parent-word magnitude and is invariant under nonzero scalar rescaling

rank_contract.policy: singular values greater than relative_tolerance times the largest nonzero singular value or a declared covariant parent-word magnitude
